record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: For a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal z(N0), let S_- be the backward shift on z(N0) and let r(S_-|z) be its spectral radius. Determine whether the spectrum of S_- is always exactly the closed disk {lambda in C : |lambda| <= r(S_-|z)}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{N}_0 = \{0,1,2,\dots\}$ and let $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ be a quasi-Banach sequence space of complex sequences $(\xi_k)_{k\in\mathbb{N}_0}$ that is shift-monotone in the following sense: both the forward shift $S_+$ defined by $(S_+\xi)_k = \xi_{k-1}$ for $k\geq 1$ and $(S_+\xi)_0 = 0$, and the backward shift $S_-$ defined by $(S_-\xi)_k = \xi_{k+1}$, map $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ continuously into itself with operator norms at most $1$. Equivalently, $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ is a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal.

Consider $S_-$ as a bounded linear operator on $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$, and let
$$r(S_-\mid z) = \lim_{n\to\infty} \|S_-^n\|^{1/n}$$
denote its spectral radius, and $\sigma(S_-\mid z) \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ its spectrum.

Determine whether, for every such quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$, one has
$$\sigma(S_-\mid z) = \{\lambda \in \mathbb{C} : |\lambda| \leq r(S_-\mid z)\}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem about the spectrum of the backward shift on quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideals; no published resolution was located.
